note: Official HKU Faculty of Education curriculum page confirms the 300-credit BEd in Early Childhood Education and Special Education structure, including a 246-credit professional core, specialised electives, language enhancement, common core and AI literacy. It publishes examples of core and elective course names but not a stable coded course table or a semester-by-semester curriculum. Do not infer course codes from names; keep this programme as index/source-only until a public coded curriculum source is available.

Official HKU Faculty of Education curriculum page confirms the five-year BA and BEd English programme's degree components and credit totals, including English Language and Linguistics, professional core, practicum, common core and electives. The public page does not provide a stable coded course list or semester-by-semester table, and its linked programme pamphlet is not publicly retrievable through the source endpoint. Keep this programme as index/source-only until an official coded curriculum source is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS and Faculty of Science pages publish the 30-credit Common Year One structure, including named faculty compulsory, professionals-in-society, GUR and free-elective components, for five potential majors. However, the public curriculum pages do not provide stable subject codes or a semester-by-semester coded table. Do not infer codes from subject names or assign courses from individual science programmes to this umbrella scheme. Keep JS3008 as index/source-only until a public coded Common Year One curriculum is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS and Faculty of Humanities pages confirm that Humanities is a Common Year One entry scheme with four potential majors and programme selection after Year One. The public pages do not publish a stable coded table for the shared first-year curriculum. Courses verified for Chinese History and Culture, English and Applied Linguistics, Language Science and Technology, and Speech Therapy must remain bound to their respective programmes, not assigned to the umbrella scheme. Keep JS3007 as index/source-only until a public coded Common Year One curriculum is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS and FCMS curriculum pages confirm that Computer and Mathematical Sciences is a Common Year One entry scheme with seven potential majors and a competitive programme-selection process. The public pages do not publish a stable coded table for the shared first-year curriculum. Courses already verified for the underlying Applied Mathematics, Computing and AI, and Data Science schemes must remain bound to their respective programmes, not assigned to the umbrella scheme. Keep JS3006 as index/source-only until a public coded Common Year One curriculum is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS page confirms that Engineering is a common-entry scheme with sixteen potential majors and a Common Year One before programme selection. It provides no stable coded table for the shared first-year curriculum. Individual programme pages have different progression paths, credits and prerequisites, so their courses must not be assigned to the umbrella scheme. Keep this scheme as index/source-only until a public coded Common Year One curriculum is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS page confirms that Construction and Environment is a common-entry scheme with nine potential majors and a Common Year One before programme selection. It does not publish a stable coded table for the shared first-year curriculum. The individual major pages and secondary-major/minor structures have different requirements, so their courses must not be assigned to the umbrella scheme. Keep this scheme as index/source-only until a public coded Common Year One curriculum is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS page confirms that Interdisciplinary Studies is a flexible university scheme in which students design their own Major under a curriculum framework, with a graduation range of 120 to 150 credits. The public page provides no stable course-code table or single required-course list because individual study pathways differ. Keep this scheme as index/source-only and do not assign courses from other programmes to it.

Official PolyU JUPAS page describes the 2026 entry scheme, awards, curriculum structure and selected subject names, but does not publish stable subject codes or semester-by-semester course rows on the public page. Keep this programme as index/source-only until a coded curriculum source is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS page and BME programme/curriculum pages describe the 2026 entry award, 120-credit structure and broad requirement groups for Sports Science and Technology, but the public pages do not publish stable subject codes or a course table for the programme. Keep this programme as index/source-only until a coded curriculum source is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS page and BEEE programme/brochure pages describe the 2026 entry award, 120-credit plus 11 training-credit structure, curriculum progression and broad building sciences subjects, but the public pages and image-based brochure do not publish stable subject codes or a course table. Keep this programme as index/source-only until a coded curriculum source is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS page and ARCH programme page describe the 2026 entry award, 120-credit plus 2 training-credit structure, 87-credit major subjects, GUR, free electives, capstone and broad architectural competence areas, but the public pages do not publish stable subject codes or a course table. Keep this programme as index/source-only until a coded curriculum source is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS and FSN programme pages describe the 2026 entry scheme, common Year One, two major awards, 120-credit structure, WIE and broad subject areas. The linked programme requirement document redirects to PolyU single sign-on, so the public source does not provide a verifiable coded course table. Keep this programme as index/source-only until a publicly accessible coded curriculum source is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS, School of Nursing programme-structure pages and the 2025 programme pamphlet confirm the five-year Mental Health Nursing curriculum, course areas, clinical practice and graduation credits. The publicly accessible materials list subject names but do not publish a current, complete coded subject table tied to JS3337. Older exchange and examination records cannot be used as the current curriculum. Keep this programme as index/source-only until a current coded curriculum source is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS and HTI pages describe the 2026 entry programme, four-year curriculum progression, 126 academic credits plus 10 clinical/field credits, clinical attachment and current subject names by year. The public subject-information link does not provide a current coded subject table; searchable coded records are from older curricula and cannot be treated as the 2026 curriculum. Keep this programme as index/source-only until a current coded curriculum source is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS and School of Design pages confirm the 2026 Design Scheme, its common Year 1 foundation, Year 2 clusters and nine Year 3-4 specialisms. The public structure and specialism pages give curriculum descriptions and credit groups but do not publish a current coded subject table. The specialisms have dedicated pathways, so subjects from older or individual-track materials must not be assigned across the scheme. Keep this programme as index/source-only until a current coded curriculum source is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS and HTI pages confirm the 2026 four-year Radiography curriculum, its academic and clinical components, 116 academic credits plus 26 clinical/field credits, and the Medical Imaging and Radiation Therapy concentrations. The linked subject-information page does not provide a current coded subject table. Searchable examination records are from older curricula and cannot be treated as the 2026 curriculum. Keep this programme as index/source-only until a current coded curriculum source is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS and Rehabilitation Sciences pages confirm the 2026 four-year Occupational Therapy curriculum, named subject areas by year, 130 credits including 24 clinical/field credits, and five clinical-placement blocks. The public sources do not provide a current complete coded subject table. Searchable examination records cannot alone establish the 2026 curriculum, so keep this programme as index/source-only until a current coded curriculum source is available.

Official PolyU JUPAS and School of Nursing pages confirm the 2026 five-year Nursing curriculum, 117 academic credits plus 35 clinical/field credits and its broad subject areas. A publicly listed coded table belongs to the separate three-year senior-year-admission programme, with different entry requirements and credits, so it cannot be assigned to JS3648. Keep the five-year programme as index/source-only until a current coded curriculum source is available.

The official 2025-26 Handbook publishes 57 units across 14 fixed coded courses, including the 6-unit ITS3005 Internship and two 6-unit Honours Project courses. It separately requires 36 units of Personalised Knowledge and Skills selected, with an Academic Supervisor and approval, from any HKBU courses except those offered by the School of Chinese Medicine. That open, student-specific component has no stable exhaustive code pool; the Programme page also does not publish closed code lists for University Core, General Education or Free Electives. Publishing only the 14 fixed courses would misrepresent this highly individualised curriculum as complete. Keep JS2950 index/source-only until an official versioned source defines a complete Programme-specific pool; the 2026-27 Handbook is currently access-restricted.

The official programme-specific 2026/27 A5B109 course-list PDF publishes 41 codes and titles across Discipline Studies Major, Education Major, Cross-faculty Core, Education Studies Core and Pedagogy groups. These verified published courses are exposed as a partial planning list. The PDF does not publish per-course credit points, Year/Semester assignments, Major Elective or Cross-faculty selection counts, the Education Studies Restricted Elective pool, or coded lists for Field Experience, General Education, Language Enhancement and Final Year Project, so the list must not be presented as a complete 156-cp graduation structure.

The official 2026-27 Major Programme Requirement publishes the 66-unit structure, 11 required CHLL codes and four Specialty elective code groups, but the official 2026-27 Course Offerings page exposes only 19 unique CHLL codes and does not verify current titles and units for the remaining curriculum pool. The Major Requirement also repeats CHLL3402 in the Modern Chinese Literature list, so the complete current code pool cannot be reconciled without inference. Keep JS4018 index-only and do not publish an annual offering subset as the full Major curriculum.

The official current Programme page confirms a two-year full-time articulation honours programme, a minimum 69-unit graduation requirement and 220 hours of supervised field work. It displays accordion headings for AY2025-26 and AY2022-23 course lists, but both published accordion bodies are empty and the page resources contain no course codes, titles, units or group table. Do not infer individual credits from the 69-unit total or copy Public Health courses into this distinct articulation programme. Keep CHPRN index/source-only until the School publishes a coded course list.

The official current Programme page confirms a two-year full-time articulation honours programme, a minimum 69-unit graduation requirement and a 180-hour Gerontological Practicum. It displays accordion headings for AY2025-26 and AY2022-23 course lists, but both published accordion bodies are empty and the page resources contain no course codes, titles, units or group table. Do not infer individual credits from the 69-unit total or copy similarly named public-health courses into Gerontology. Keep BSCGB index/source-only until the School publishes a coded course list.

The official current Curriculum page and the complete visually reviewed 16-page 2026-27 Programme brochure publish Faculty Package, Required-course and nine Concentration titles, but no stable course codes or per-course units. Each Concentration requires at least five courses, while the detailed current-student curriculum is access-restricted through SharePoint. Do not infer codes from course titles or merge courses from other CUHK Business Programmes. Keep JS4202 index/source-only until a publicly accessible current coded curriculum is available.

The official current LLB Programme page and the complete visually reviewed 11-page 2026-27 brochure publish the 127-unit four-year structure, 42 compulsory Law units, 48 elective Law units, all named compulsory subjects and a broad list of elective titles. Neither source publishes stable course codes or per-course units, and the brochure explicitly states that elective courses vary year to year. The Faculty WordPress media and site search expose current LLB brochures but no current coded LLB course list. Do not infer codes from titles, reuse codes from another university or treat the illustrative elective list as a fixed curriculum. Keep JS4903 index/source-only until CUHK LAW publishes a current Programme-specific coded course table.

The official current Programme site, Undergraduate Admissions page and complete visually reviewed nine-page V2024.10 Programme booklet publish the Year 1-3 Faculty Package, Major Core and Major Elective titles, all three Concentration Areas, and the Capstone Research Project or Biomedical Internship experiential paths. None publishes stable course codes or per-course units. The only coded item found on the Programme site's public HTML belongs to unrelated news content, while the Student Portal links to access-restricted SharePoint. Do not infer codes from course titles or copy courses from another Medicine or Science Programme. Keep JS4550 index/source-only until the School publishes a current Programme-specific coded curriculum.

The official current Programme page publishes the 123-unit graduation total and a topic-level process model covering the Faculty Package, public-health tools and domains, Research Project and Practicum, but it does not publish a coded study scheme or per-course units. Its AY2025-26, AY2023-24 and AY2022-23 Course List accordions are present but their public bodies are empty. A separate unfinished Wix sample collection exposes only three PHPC-labelled cards with placeholder descriptions, stock activity images and 1-credit template fields; it is not a Programme curriculum and must not be imported. Do not infer courses from the topic diagram or treat template content as official evidence. Keep JS4537 index/source-only until the School publishes a current Programme-specific coded course table.

The official current Programme site and complete visually reviewed 17-page 2026-27 brochure publish the 123-unit structure, including the 71-unit Major Programme, 9-unit Faculty Package, 35-unit Required block, 27-unit Elective block and four optional Concentrations. The brochure names every Required, Elective and Concentration course but publishes no course codes or per-course units. The public Study Scheme page has no body, while the Course List page only links an old sample grade descriptor and does not supply a coded curriculum. Do not map titles to codes from another department or infer individual credits from group totals. Keep JS4838 index/source-only until the Programme publishes a current coded course table.

The official current Undergraduate page publishes the integrated 72-unit Earth and Environmental Sciences Major, its Foundation/Intermediate/Advanced three-layer structure, and General, Atmospheric Science, Geology and Geophysics, and Environmental Science and Technology paths. The complete visually reviewed six-page 2026 leaflet (8,284,645 bytes; SHA-256 f3be58b977b51aae29afb9338423ede3b6e314edd93a9225036b738018a5105a) likewise publishes course and focus-area titles but no stable Programme-specific code-title-unit table. Codes shown on the webpage are admission-eligibility prerequisite choices rather than the Major curriculum. The linked CUHK AQS public Programme browser returned a System error during review and did not expose a current coded scheme. Do not map the highlight titles to codes from the retired ESSC/ENSC Programmes or infer individual units from the 72-unit group totals. Keep JS4648 index/source-only until an accessible current coded EESC requirement is published.

The official HKU admission page confirms that the BEng Elite Programme is an umbrella route whose students may choose Civil Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Industrial Engineering and Logistics Management, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or Artificial Intelligence and Data Science as their BEng degree. The current public evidence set closes only some of those degree curricula and does not provide one complete Programme-local curriculum covering all eight choices. Do not merge courses from different degrees into the existing aggregate Major or present a subset as the complete Elite Programme. Keep 6303 index-only until every choice has a current official coded curriculum and can be represented as an isolated Programme-local Major.

The official HKU admission page confirms that this 4+1 scheme combines one of six BEng degrees - Civil Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Industrial Engineering and Logistics Management, or Mechanical Engineering - with the MSc(Eng) in Artificial Intelligence in Engineering, and that students may opt out after completing the chosen bachelor's degree. The current public evidence set does not close all six cohort-specific BEng curricula together with the MSc component. Do not copy only the available Civil and Mechanical Engineering lists, merge different degrees into one Major, or omit the postgraduate component while presenting the result as the complete 6377 scheme. Keep 6377 index-only until every degree path and the MSc component can be represented with current official coded evidence.

The current official HKUMed Bachelor of Nursing programme outline publishes the five-year, 303-credit, 44-course curriculum by year and semester, including course titles, credits and practica, but it does not publish course codes. The official 6418 admissions page confirms that the Advanced Leadership Track builds on this BNurs curriculum and adds a Leadership Development Programme plus optional articulation to MNurs or MBBS, without a coded ALT-specific course table. Do not map older NURS codes onto the current title-only structure or copy the ordinary BNurs outline as a complete ALT curriculum. Keep 6418 index-only until an official current coded curriculum and the ALT-specific components are publicly available.

The current official HKUMed Bachelor of Nursing programme outline publishes a complete five-year, 303-credit, 44-course structure by year and semester, with course titles, credits and practica, but no course codes. The 2025-26 HKU Degree Regulations and Curricula page links to this title-only programme outline rather than a current coded syllabus. Do not reuse the 2024-25 BNurs PDF codes as if they were verified for the current curriculum. Keep 6468 index-only until HKU publishes a current stable coded course table.

The official HKU School of Innovation 2026 programme leaflet describes the four-year project-led curriculum, integrated foundational courses spanning science, technology, design and entrepreneurship, a personalised technology focus, a six-to-eight-month full-time co-op and a startup-like capstone. It does not publish any course codes, per-course credits, fixed foundation-course titles or a closed technology-focus pool. Do not construct a curriculum from similarly named HKU courses or treat the illustrative project themes as courses. Keep 6602 index-only until the School publishes a current coded curriculum.

The official 2025-26 BBA(Law)&LLB syllabus applies to the 2025-26 cohort and thereafter, subject to approval. It closes the 300-credit structure, the five named Business Major paths, the Accounting Professional Core and every fixed Law core code. Current BBA and LLB syllabuses close the five Business Major pools, the designated Law capstone pool and the designated disciplinary-elective subset. However, the 6808 syllabus requires 42 credits of Law disciplinary electives from a broader LLAWxxxx universe and does not publish that complete universe in the Programme-specific table. Publish the six isolated Programme-local Stream/Major lists for read-only planning, but do not present them as a complete graduation structure or calculate a completion percentage.

The official Programme-specific table applies to the 2024-25 cohort and thereafter and closes the 300-credit category totals, fixed PPA and Law core codes, PPA capstone alternatives, language codes, ten Law capstone alternatives and seven designated Law disciplinary electives. The current 2025-26 LLB syllabus removes LLAW3058 from the capstone pool and renames LLAW3230 from Business of justice clinic to Public interest clinic, so publish only the nine-code current capstone intersection using the current title. The current BSocSc syllabus supplies the coded Social Innovation and Global Citizenship alternatives. The Programme-specific table still requires eight PPA electives and 42 credits of Law electives without publishing either complete Programme-local pool; it also leaves the FOSS introductory course, Common Core and free electives unnamed. Expose the 54 verified codes for read-only planning, but do not present them as a complete graduation structure or calculate a completion percentage.

The current official School of Biomedical Engineering Programme page describes the interdisciplinary curriculum, learning themes and professional preparation for the Bachelor of Engineering in Biomedical Engineering, but it does not publish a coded course table, per-course credits or course groups. The Faculty of Engineering Regulations and Syllabuses page at https://engg.hku.hk/Teaching-Learning/BEng-BASc/Academic-Programmes/Regulations-Syllabuses currently links BME Regulations and Syllabus only for 2024 and leaves the 2025 columns empty. Do not reuse the 2024 BME syllabus for the 2026 cohort without a current applicability statement. Keep 6925 index/source-only until HKU publishes a current coded curriculum.

The current official BSc&LLB admissions page confirms a five-year double degree and twelve selectable catalogue entries: eleven Science Major choices plus an LLB professional-core entry. It describes specially designed courses and capstone experiences but does not publish the Programme-specific coded curriculum, category credits, overlap rules or completion paths. Current standalone BSc and LLB syllabuses publish component course codes, but they do not establish which rows, substitutions, electives or capstones apply inside the combined 6858 curriculum. Do not copy the 6901 BSc Major lists or standalone LLB list into 6858 and present the result as a complete double degree. Keep all twelve entries index-only until HKU publishes a current Programme-specific coded structure.

The current official admissions entry for 6897 publishes only the three degree names and the statement 'Subject to approval'; it does not publish a study period, Programme type, coded course table, credits, groups or a mapping to the separately listed 6987 admission entry. The Faculty 2025-26 CE/EE/ElecE syllabus applies to those degrees but does not identify 6897 as the applicable admission code. Do not copy the verified 6987 Major lists into 6897 without an official code mapping or an approved Programme-specific curriculum. Keep 6897 index/source-only until HKU publishes that evidence.

The official current CLED Programme site publishes a 156-unit double-degree structure and extensive required/elective subject-title lists across Chinese Language and Literature and Chinese Language Education. It does not publish individual course codes or per-course units. Its Major-GPA note identifies CHLL, CHLT, CLED and EDUC prefixes at level 2000 or above but does not map those prefixes to the listed titles. Do not infer codes from titles, copy similarly named Chinese-department courses or divide group totals across rows. Keep JS4331 index/source-only until the Programme publishes a current code-title-unit table.
